  "memo":"R01 holds, establishing Account access. No other adverse or Context rule holds; no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Country mismatch alone does not establish R03 because neither AVS nor CVV failed. Travel or a new device could initially explain the activity, but the completed contact check failed. Under FP-2 §5.3(b), decline is standard; escalation is prohibited without Linkage. The failure decides the order, so no further check is needed. As the order has not shipped, decline voids and refunds it and blocks the account. This recommendation is advisory and sets no queue priority."
